## Goal
The runner records every state change as an `Event` with `from_state`/`to_state` (`engine/runner.py:534-542`); a listing that returns after removal is `REMOVED -> REAPPEARED` (`state.py:78-80`). `Listing.gone_since` is cleared when the listing is seen again (`runner.py:166-168`), so the only history of a relist is in the events. Add a pure `relist_gaps(events) -> dict[str, list[int]]` to `monitor.py`: given Events (newest first, as `Store.events` returns them, `storage/db.py:372-382`), return per broker id the whole-day gaps between each `to_state == REMOVED` event and the next `to_state == REAPPEARED` event for the same broker. Events for other brokers, other actions and malformed rows are ignored. No store access, no network.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. A fake event list with two remove-then-relist cycles for one broker returns both gaps in chronological order.
2. A removal with no later relist yields no gap (open cycle); a relist with no earlier removal yields no gap.
3. Two brokers interleaved are separated correctly; events with `broker_id` None or the reserved tag `_checklist` (`checklist_state.py:26`) are ignored.
4. Same-day remove and relist gives a gap of 0 (kept; the interval helper ignores non-positive gaps).
5. Events with naive and aware timestamps in the same list do not raise (treat naive as UTC); input order (newest first or oldest first) gives the same answer.
6. Event `detail` is never read, so PII-free by construction; the function accepts `Event` objects and returns only ints keyed by broker id.
7. Existing tests pass unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
